---
title: "simstim host create"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Make a new host with a provider (lima, docker, e2b), install the helper and connect.

```text
simstim host create <provider> [name] [flags]
```

Make a host and set it up in one step: a local Lima VM, a Docker container (experimental), or an E2B sandbox. Creating a host counts as consent to install the helper on it; what is installed, and where, is printed. The name defaults to the provider's name.

## Examples

```sh
simstim host create lima
simstim host create docker test --image debian:stable-slim
simstim host create e2b cloud --template simstim
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--cpus <int>` | lima: CPUs (default: `2`) |
| `--disk <int>` | lima: disk in GiB (sparse: it grows as it fills) (default: `40`) |
| `--idle-stop <string>` | stop after this long with no client and no working session, or never (lima: 30m, e2b: 15m) |
| `--image <string>` | docker: the image, which needs sh, bash and coreutils (default: `debian:stable-slim`) |
| `--memory <int>` | lima: memory in GiB (default: `4`) |
| `--template <string>` | e2b: the template, which sets CPUs and memory (default: `simstim`) |
| `--token-command <string>` | e2b: a command that prints the API key, if E2B_API_KEY is not set and the E2B CLI is not logged in |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
